packageRules.description: The js-yaml entry under `overrides` is a security floor: it lifts the dev dependency tree above GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh, fixed in 4.3.2. Both consumers are on the 4.x line: @directus/utils (through @directus/extensions-sdk) pins 4.3.2 exactly and loads it with a default import, and cosmiconfig asks for ^4.1.0. js-yaml 5 has no default export, so an override at ^5 breaks `npm run build` with "does not provide an export named 'default'". Lift once @directus/utils accepts js-yaml 5.
